alt: German Finance Ministry Drafts 25% Tax on Crypto Gains From 2027

items.h: Compound Opens Institutional Market With 87% LTV
items.s: The market takes ETH, wstETH, WBTC and cbBTC as collateral against USDC at loan-to-value ratios of up to 87%. Compound says borrowing is open to anyone, with approval required only for the 200,000 USDC in supplier rewards.
